text:
maya: Heads up, after last night's BMC firmware roll (v3.2.1) I'm seeing a spike in IPMI retransmits on rack-uw1-2/3. GPUs are getting evicted during provisioning. Logs show a lot of 'ipmi: retransmit timeout' and `kernel: bmc-conn reset` entries. Anyone else?

jamie: saw something similar in eu-west but much smaller. Did the roll include secure-boot flag changes?

deploy-bot: Firmware deploy completed: v3.2.1 -> rack-uw1-* (started 2026-03-20T03:12Z). Release notes: keystore GC, secureboot toggle, nvram cleanup.

maya: yes, secureboot flag update was part of the patch to address nvram leak. I suspect the keystore GC timing is colliding with IPMI keepalive and causing retransmits.

sam: can you paste `ipmitool lan print` or a short log snippet from an affected node?

maya: snippet: ```Mar 20 03:15:01 hostbmc ipmi_smi: retransmit timeout seq=42 retries=5
Mar 20 03:15:02 hostbmc bmc: kernel: watchdog stopped
Mar 20 03:15:02 hostbmc ipmi_smi: link reset requested
```

nina: ops — starting a canary rollback on rack-uw1-2, cordoning hosts and draining GPUs now to limit evictions.

corey: quick Q: if we rollback BMC firmware, do running pods get killed or just provisioning fails? Will allocations bounce?

nina: cordon + drain will evict pods gracefully. We should use `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` to avoid leftover local state. Running jobs will be rescheduled if capacity available.

maya: note on cost: these evictions are triggering extra reboots and preemptible charges — rough estimate +$120/hr across the rack while it's noisy.

sre-oncall: taking ownership. I'll coordinate the rollback and monitor provisioning latency / eviction rate.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered for rack-uw1-2 by @nina (run id: 87321).

jamie: please capture keystore GC interval and secureboot toggle state for both v3.2.1 and v3.2.0 so firmware team can repro. I’ll open a quick runbook item.

maya: will attach logs and a short repro. Also tagging @firmware-team for GC/secureboot interaction investigation.

sre-oncall: rolling monitoring alert to warn at 5% GPU eviction rate and 30s+ provisioning latency.

maya: thanks — will update here with progress and log bundle once rollback finishes.
